    <description>GlideAjax front door for BoxEmbedService. Extends AbstractAjaxProcessor and delegates to BoxEmbedService.build(), which performs the x_bonh_box.box_user role check and access_gate subflow call before returning an embed URL.</description>
    <mobile_callable>false</mobile_callable>
    <name>BoxEmbedServiceAjax</name>
    <sandbox_callable>false</sandbox_callable>
    <script><![CDATA[/**
 * BoxEmbedServiceAjax (x_637605_box_ext_0)
 *
 * Thin GlideAjax front door for BoxEmbedService.
 *
 * BoxEmbedService itself is a plain class and deliberately NOT client-callable:
 * the vendor's original carried client_callable = true without extending
 * AbstractAjaxProcessor, so GlideAjax calls against it could never have worked.
 * This wrapper is the piece that actually extends AbstractAjaxProcessor.
 *
 * Security: this endpoint is reachable by any authenticated user, so it holds no
 * authorization logic of its own. Every call delegates to BoxEmbedService.build(),
 * which runs the x_bonh_box.box_user role check and the vendor's access_gate
 * subflow before any embed URL or login token is produced.
 *
 * Client usage:
 *   var ga = new GlideAjax('x_637605_box_ext_0.BoxEmbedServiceAjax');
 *   ga.addParam('sysparm_name', 'buildEmbedUrl');
 *   ga.addParam('sysparm_box_item_type', 'folder');
 *   ga.addParam('sysparm_box_item_id', '123456789');
 *   ga.addParam('sysparm_source', 'Workspace');
 *   ga.getXMLAnswer(function (answer) {
 *       var result = JSON.parse(answer);
 *       // { success, embedUrl, reason, authUrl, message }
 *       // reason is '' on success, else sn_role | auth | role | validation |
 *       // config | error. message is plain text; render your own link from
 *       // authUrl when reason is 'auth'.
 *   });
 *
 * Requires the sys_security_acl of type client_callable_script_include declared
 * in src/fluent/acls.now.ts. Without it every call is denied.
 */
var BoxEmbedServiceAjax = Class.create()

BoxEmbedServiceAjax.prototype = Object.extendsObject(global.AbstractAjaxProcessor, {
    buildEmbedUrl: function () {
        var itemType = this.getParameter('sysparm_box_item_type')
        var itemId = this.getParameter('sysparm_box_item_id')
        var source = this.getParameter('sysparm_source')

        var result
        try {
            result = new BoxEmbedService().build(itemType, itemId, source)
        } catch (e) {
            gs.error('[BoxEmbedServiceAjax] buildEmbedUrl failed: ' + e)
            result = {
                success: false,
                embedUrl: '',
                reason: 'error',
                authUrl: '',
                message: 'The Box embed could not be built right now. Please try again.',
            }
        }

        return JSON.stringify(result)
    },

    type: 'BoxEmbedServiceAjax',
})
]]></script>
    <sys_name>BoxEmbedServiceAjax</sys_name>
  </sys_script_include>
